note: JSERC's depreciation, normative loan, equity and return on equity for JBVNL over the control period FY2026-27 to FY2030-31 (Tables 124, 125, 127, 133), each year opening on the previous year's computed closings: the rate as the audited depreciation over the audited average GFA (Clause 10.39; printed 4.39 %, applied unrounded), the loan's repayment equal to the year's depreciation, and the return as the order applies it — 14.50 % on the equity before 1 April 2026 and 15.00 % on half the equity added since (J2).  Table 124's figures are Rs lakh under a 'Rs. Crore' heading (J1); the rate, a ratio, is unaffected.
